description: Find one person's work email at a company domain. Returns the address, whether it was found publicly or inferred from the company's pattern, Hunter's real verification status (valid, accept_all, unknown, invalid), a confidence score, the pages it was seen on and a recommendation. Price: $0.08 USDC on Base via x402, charged only when an address is returned (no result = not charged); this MCP call returns payment instructions for POST /v1/email. Read-only; never sends email. 'valid' means the mail server accepted the address, not that a person reads it.

domain.description: Company email domain, for example stripe.com.

found_only.description: If true, return only addresses found publicly (no pattern inference).

full_name.description: Alternative to first_name + last_name: the full name.

name: email_lookup

payment.description: Payment instructions. MCP tools/call does not charge or run the paid work; call the HTTP route with x402.

amount.description: Price in USDC base units (6 decimals).

body.description: JSON body to POST (the tool arguments you sent).

method.description: HTTP method for the paid route.

price.description: Price in USD, paid as USDC.

result.description: Paid result: { outcome, email, address_origin, verification: { status, provider }, confidence: { score }, evidence: { sources }, recommendation, billing }.

status.description: payment_required: pay the HTTP route with x402 to get the result. ok: result is included.
